title: PrvTel
summary: PrvTel generates synthetic network telemetry data (from CAIDA, NF-IoT, DDoS and Cisco telemetry datasets) using a VAE with differential privacy for downstream analysis and ML evaluation. It uses RDT's numerical and categorical transformers directly to preprocess and reversibly encode telemetry fields before model training.
